label: Google queue
description: Products waiting to be sent to Google. The courier removes an item once Google answered for every offer of the product.

input_ids.description: Product inputs to delete when the product itself is gone

done_input_ids.description: Inputs already sent for this revision of the product, so a product too big for one run continues where it stopped

revision.description: Bumped on every change, so the courier never removes an item edited while it was being sent
